comments.comment:
'PUNCH' on zfs is "Operation not supported" in this case; in latest master we have:

if [[ "$ost1_FSTYPE" == "zfs" ]]; then
    # test 5b: EC resync hole-punches stale parity, but osd-zfs has no
    # fallocate hole-punch, so resync fails with EOPNOTSUPP (LU-20435)
    always_except LU-20435 5b 12b
fi

where 5b is skipped, so rebase on master should fix this error
